name: Kc9h9d leave-one-board-out (secondary, diagnostic only)
registered: 2026-10-02, flops in progress, before any Vext table / point / bootstrap result
method: node 6 table = Vext estimator with Kc9h9d removed from paired/KQ (that stratum re-averaged over its other 16 boards; P(stratum) and all other strata unchanged); node 28 table = its Vext table unchanged (Kc9h9d is not in the node 28 panel); same solver config; one preflop point solve G_lobo. Compared with Gext.
metrics: aggregates (BTN / SB / BB node frequencies) difference
seat EV difference (raw EV and seat-swap dEV of sigma_lobo into Gext)
5-node class regret excess of sigma_lobo in Gext
argmax switch count and reach share per node
interpretation: practical sensitivity: the effect of the whole board is expected to dominate the effect of its solver residual; this is NOT a rigorous bound on the residual. Primary results (board included) and the panel are not changed whatever the outcome; no automatic top-up.
command: python3 tools/gto_hu_continuation/a4c_run.py lobo   (after points, before boot)

hand_level_definitions.amended: 2026-10-02, before the LOBO point result (flops still running)
hand_level_definitions.policy_argmax_switch: the action with the highest policy frequency differs between Gext and LOBO; it is a most-frequent-policy-action switch, NOT a best-EV action switch
hand_level_definitions.EV_argmax_switch: optional secondary: the action with the highest action EV differs
hand_level_definitions.weighting: primary = Gext baseline class reach (class_reach_before at the node in Gext); LOBO reach reported as secondary
hand_level_definitions.L1: reach-weighted strategy L1, primary Gext reach (seat-swap L1 already uses the Gext node reach), LOBO reach secondary
hand_level_definitions.note: a4c_analyze.hand_level (main 144 vs ext analysis) is not changed by this; it is not used by the LOBO diagnostic any more
hand_level_definitions.reach_finding: class_reach_before is the actor's own reach r0[actor] before the node (t2_cont_terminal.rs path_nodes). In all 5 nodes (BTN first-in, SB vs BTN, BB vs BTN, SB first-in, BB vs SB) the actor has not acted before, so this weight is the combo-count prior (6/4/12 combos per class, /1326) and is strategy-independent: Gext and LOBO weights are identical by construction (checked: max |diff| = 0.0 between A4b V144 and boot r01). Both fields are still reported; the secondary will equal the primary. The same holds for a4c_analyze.hand_level.
